title: Outbound Scaling
tagline: How EvaWarm helped Attentive scale from 500 to 8,000 emails per day across 12 domains with zero deliverability incidents over four consecutive months.
about: Attentive is a marketing technology company serving mid-market and enterprise e-commerce brands. As they expanded their outbound sales motion, they needed to scale cold email from 500 to 8,000 emails per day across multiple domains without triggering spam filters.
objective: Design a multi-domain sending architecture that could grow safely from 500 to 8,000 emails per day, maintain separate identities for different outreach personas, and sustain "High" Google Postmaster Tool reputation throughout.
challenges: Previous scaling attempts caused Google Postmaster scores to drop to "Bad" within days, forcing domain abandonment
No structured warmup — volume increases were ad hoc, triggering ISP anomaly detection
Multiple outreach personas needed separate domain identities, requiring multi-domain architecture
Reply routing was broken — replies from prospects did not reach the correct sales rep's inbox
No monitoring in place — deliverability failures were discovered after revenue impact, not before
ISPs flag domains that increase volume faster than 40% per day as suspicious senders

solutions.title: Multi-Domain Portfolio Design
solutions.desc: 12 sending domains purpose-built for specific outreach personas, warmed sequentially so at least 8 mature domains were always available for production sending.

solutions.title: Full Authentication Stack
solutions.desc: Each domain received strict SPF, 2048-bit DKIM, DMARC graduated from "none" to "reject", and BIMI records on highest-volume domains for Gmail brand trust.

solutions.title: Reply Routing Fix
solutions.desc: Configured separate MX routing per domain so prospect replies landed in the correct sales rep's inbox, maintaining the engagement loop and generating positive sender signals.

solutions.title: 21-Day Sequential Warmup
solutions.desc: Each domain followed a 21-day manual warmup protocol with a maximum 40% daily volume increase, before entering production rotation.

solutions.title: Continuous Monitoring
solutions.desc: Daily checks across Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, and Barracuda reputation data. Any anomaly triggered an automatic domain hold pending investigation.

solutions.title: Rotating Domain System
solutions.desc: New domains always being warmed in the background, so production capacity could grow steadily without any single domain bearing sudden volume jumps.

stats.label: Scaling Duration
stats.sub: no domain abandoned in that period

takeaway: The infrastructure Attentive built with EvaWarm is now a competitive advantage. While peers periodically lose days or weeks to deliverability crises, Attentive's outbound programme runs without interruption — and scales on demand.
conclusion: Scaling email volume safely is an engineering problem as much as a marketing one. Attentive's success came from treating it that way — systematic design, disciplined protocols, and daily measurement rather than ad-hoc volume pushes.
